name: Notion
verdict: A working OAuth connection in about 4 minutes, no review. The trap is the very first choice: Notion defaults to a single-workspace API token, and the install scope you pick for OAuth is locked once the connection is created.

approval.label: None for OAuth
approval.note: Marketplace listing is optional and separate.

handsOn.note: Form, capabilities, then a page-sharing hint for your users.

waiting.note: Nothing to wait for unless you list on the Marketplace.

ownApp.headline: Check Composio first; your own connection is cheap here.
ownApp.note: We could not confirm a Composio-managed Notion app. Your own connection needs no review.

oneWayDoors.title: API token is the default authentication method.
oneWayDoors.detail: The New connection form preselects "API token": workspace-scoped, shared across collaborators, limited to 1 workspace and not Marketplace-eligible.
oneWayDoors.doThis: Choose "OAuth" for any agent your customers will connect.

oneWayDoors.title: Install scope is locked after creation.
oneWayDoors.detail: For OAuth, "Installable in" defaults to Any workspace. After creation it shows read-only. A connection limited to selected workspaces cannot be listed on the Marketplace.
oneWayDoors.doThis: Keep "Any workspace". Use a separate connection for internal testing if needed.

oneWayDoors.title: Deleting a connection revokes everyone.
oneWayDoors.detail: The danger zone says deleting revokes access for everyone who installed it.
oneWayDoors.doThis: Never delete a live connection to "start fresh"; create a new one alongside.

items.name: API token connection
items.when: The default choice in the form.
items.useFor: Internal scripts and your own workspace

items.name: OAuth connection, any workspace
items.whoCanInstall: Any Notion user, each authorizes individually

items.name: OAuth, selected workspaces
items.whoCanInstall: Only workspaces you pick at creation
items.useFor: Pilots with named customers; not Marketplace-eligible

notes.title: Integrations are now "Connections"
notes.text: The developer area moved to app.notion.com/developers under "Developer tools", with Connections, Workers, Personal access tokens and MCP tokens. Older guides point to notion.so/my-integrations.

scopes.intro: Notion uses capabilities set on the connection, not OAuth scope strings. Users then choose which pages to share during consent.

scopes: Read user information including email addresses
rows.impact: Default option; narrow it if you don't need emails

minimalSets.label: "Answer questions from docs" agent
minimalSets.note: Turn off update and insert, and pick "No user information".

changingLater: Capabilities can be edited on the connection page.
Page access is per user: users must re-share pages if your agent needs new ones.
No review is triggered by capability changes.

toCreate: A Notion workspace (it becomes the connection's development workspace)
An HTTPS redirect URI with no fragments, wildcards, relative paths or public IP addresses
Agreement to Notion's Developer Terms (accepted when you create)
forApproval: Only for a Marketplace listing: listing content and images, managed under Listings

steps.title: Sign in to Notion
steps.detail: Then open Developer tools, Connections. notion.so/profile/integrations redirects there.

steps.title: Switch authentication to OAuth
steps.detail: The form defaults to API token (decision 1).

steps.title: Add the redirect URI
steps.detail: Pick the typed value from the suggestion list or it is not saved. This tripped our agent once.

steps.title: Approve Create connection
steps.detail: This also accepts Notion's Developer Terms.

steps.title: Narrow capabilities
steps.detail: Defaults include update, insert and reading user emails. Turn off what your agent does not need.

steps.title: Copy credentials into Composio
steps.detail: Client ID and secret from the Configuration tab. A ready-made authorization URL is shown too.

stepsNote: Total in our test: about 4 minutes of agent work and one approval.

approval.whenNeeded: Never for OAuth. Only to list on the Notion Marketplace.

stages.label: Marketplace
stages.detail: Optional listing review; timeline not documented on pages we read.

submit: Marketplace only: listing description, categories, images
rejections: Connection limited to selected workspaces (not eligible)

ladder.limit: Agent only sees pages the user shared at consent.
Each user authorizes individually; only they can use it in their workspace.

notes.title: Empty results are the top support issue
notes.text: Users pick pages during consent. If they share nothing, your agent sees nothing. Tell users in your product which pages to share.

rows.breaks: User removes the connection or the pages

tokens.note: Token lifetime and refresh behaviour were not checked in this pass.

rules.title: User-scoped access.
rules.text: Access is limited to the signed-in user and the pages they share.

rules.title: Defaults are broad.
rules.text: New connections can read user email addresses unless you change it.

impact.title: Design impact
impact.text: Ask only for capabilities you use; the consent screen shows them to every user.

credentialHandoff.summary: No creation API that we found. An agent can fill the console and copy the secret into Composio. The secret stayed masked in our test.

blockers.symptom: Only one workspace can use the integration
blockers.cause: Created with API token, or OAuth limited to selected workspaces
blockers.fix: Create a new OAuth connection with Any workspace

blockers.cause: User shared no pages at consent
blockers.fix: Ask the user to reconnect and share the right pages

blockers.cause: Typed value not selected from the suggestion list
blockers.fix: Select it so it becomes a chip

evidence.claim: API token is the default; OAuth must be chosen

evidence.basis: Not documented on pages we read
